We perform human evaluation via crowdflower platform. Given a test sentence, we generate n sentences ... ask three annotators to rank these sentences from 1 to n and provide an absolute score for relatedness (R) of the generated sentences on a scale of 1 to 10.

We ask them to provide an absolute score for relatedness (R) of the generated sentences with respect to the original sentence in a scale of 1 to 10, 1 being least related, we rescale it and present the result in the scale of 0 to 1.
